exposure: Buprenorphine treatment for opioid use disorder
cohort: 16 pregnancies in 14 women with opioid use disorder who were treated with buprenorphine in a collaborative care model during pregnancy
finding: A collaborative care approach to buprenorphine treatment for opioid use disorder during pregnancy is feasible.
mod_finding: The majority (60%) of women in the study had a cesarean delivery.
gest_age: Average gestational age at referral was 23.6 weeks
